notes.title: Road Map Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/5712a07710a7bcdbc8be2616d333674c10db491f.png[/img]

We have a new story writer [url=https://twitter.com/JuneberryChan]@Juneberry [/url]! We've finished adding all key points to the map, adding black jack, slot machines, and all other mini games to the game as well! With that we're on one of our final and main steps to finishing Pixacrea the video game!  Why would we have to mention "the video game" you may be wondering?! That's because we've also been hard at work making a collectable trading card game for everyone who may be interested!
